verses.en: Hā Mīm .

verses.ar: وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۙۛ‏
verses.en: By the manifest Book,

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ فِيۡ لَيۡلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنۡذِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people).

verses.ar: فِيۡهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ اَمۡرٍ حَكِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.en: In that (night), every wise matter is allocated

verses.ar: اَمۡرًا مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: through a command from Us. We were to send the Messenger

verses.ar: رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: as a mercy from your Lord, -Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing-

verses.ar: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever there is between them, if you are to believe.

verses.ar: لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُؕ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ اٰبَآئِكُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: There is no god, but He. He gives life and brings death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.ar: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ
verses.en: But they, being in doubt, are playing around.

verses.ar: فَارۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَاۡتِي السَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: So, wait for a day when the sky will come up with a visible smoke

verses.ar: يَّغۡشَي النَّاسَؕ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: that will envelop people. This is a painful punishment.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا اكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا الۡعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Then they will say,) “O our Lord, remove from us the punishment; we will truly believe.”

verses.ar: اَنّٰي لَهُمُ الذِّكۡرٰي وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: How will they take lesson, while there has already come to them a messenger making things clear?

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡا عَنۡهُ وَقَالُوۡا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجۡنُوۡنٌۘ‏
verses.en: Then they turned away from him, and said, “(He is) tutored, crazy.”

verses.ar: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الۡعَذَابِ قَلِيۡلًا اِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُوۡنَۘ‏
verses.en: (Well,) We are going to remove the punishment for a while, (but) you will certainly go back (to your original position).

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ الۡبَطۡشَةَ الۡكُبۡرٰيۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَقِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Then,) the day We will seize (you) with the greatest seizure, We will take vengeance.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ كَرِيۡمٌۙ‏
verses.en: And We tested the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) prior to them, and a noble messenger came to them

verses.ar: اَنۡ اَدُّوۡ٘ا اِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ اَمِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: saying, “Deliver to me the servants of Allah. I am an honest messenger to you,”

verses.ar: وَّاَنۡ لَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۚ‏
verses.en: and saying, “Do not be haughty against Allah. I bring to you a clear proof.

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّيۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ اَنۡ تَرۡجُمُوۡنِۚ‏
verses.en: And I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا لِيۡ فَاعۡتَزِلُوۡنِ
verses.en: And if you do not believe in me, then keep away from me.”

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ مُّجۡرِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then he prayed to his Lord saying, “These are a guilty people.”

verses.ar: فَاَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ لَيۡلًا اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (So, Allah answered his prayer saying,) “Now, take away my servants at night. You will certainly be chased,

verses.ar: وَاتۡرُكِ الۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
verses.en: and leave the sea in the state of stillness; they are an army that is sure to be drowned.”

verses.ar: كَمۡ تَرَكُوۡا مِنۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: How many gardens and fountains have they left behind-

verses.ar: وَّزُرُوۡعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.en: - and how many fields and noble sites,

verses.ar: وَّنَعۡمَةٍ كَانُوۡا فِيۡهَا فٰكِهِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: and how many a luxury they used to rejoice in!

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَاَوۡرَثۡنٰهَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: This is how it happened. And We made other people inherit all this.

verses.ar: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُنۡظَرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So, neither the sky and earth wept over them, nor were they given a respite.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡمُهِيۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: And We delivered the children of Isrā’īl from the humiliating punishment,

verses.ar: مِنۡ فِرۡعَوۡنَؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: from Fir‘aun. Indeed, he was haughty, one of the transgressors.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ اخۡتَرۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰي عِلۡمٍ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And We chose them, with knowledge, above all the worlds.

verses.ar: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيۡهِ بَلٰٓؤٌا مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: And We gave them the clear signs in which there was a manifest blessing.

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: These people say,

verses.ar: اِنۡ هِيَ اِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا الۡاُوۡلٰي وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنۡشَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: “There is nothing more than our first death, and we are not going to be resurrected.

verses.ar: فَاۡتُوۡا بِاٰبَآئِنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, (O believers,) bring our fathers, if you are true (in your belief in resurrection.)”

verses.ar: اَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٍۙ وَّالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡؗ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those who were before them? We have destroyed them. They were guilty indeed.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them just as players.

verses.ar: مَا خَلَقۡنٰهُمَا٘ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: We did not create them but with true purpose, but most of them do not know.

verses.ar: اِنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡفَصۡلِ مِيۡقَاتُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them-

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِيۡ مَوۡلًي عَنۡ مَّوۡلًي شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: the day when no close relation will be of any use to any close relation, nor will they be helped,

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُࣖ‏
verses.en: except the One on whom Allah has mercy. Of course, He is the All-Mighty, the Very-Merciful.

verses.ar: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: Indeed the tree of zaqqūm

verses.ar: طَعَامُ الۡاَثِيۡمِۚۛۖ‏
verses.en: is the food of the sinful,

verses.ar: كَالۡمُهۡلِۚۛ يَغۡلِيۡ فِي الۡبُطُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: like dregs of oil. It will boil in the bellies

verses.ar: كَغَلۡيِ الۡحَمِيۡمِ
verses.en: like the boiling of hot water.

verses.ar: خُذُوۡهُ فَاعۡتِلُوۡهُ اِلٰي سَوَآءِ الۡجَحِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: (It will be said to angels,) “Seize him, and drag him into the midst of the Hell.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوۡا فَوۡقَ رَاۡسِهٖ مِنۡ عَذَابِ الۡحَمِيۡمِؕ‏
verses.en: Then pour on his head some torment of boiling water.”

verses.ar: ذُقۡۚۖ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡكَرِيۡمُ
verses.en: “Have a taste! You are the ‘man of might’, the ‘man of honour’.

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: This is the thing about which you used to be skeptic.”

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ مَقَامٍ اَمِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: Indeed the God-fearing will be in a place free from fear,

verses.ar: فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۚۙ‏
verses.en: in gardens and fountains.

verses.ar: يَّلۡبَسُوۡنَ مِنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَۚۙ‏
verses.en: They will be dressed in fine silk and thick silk, facing each other.

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍؕ‏
verses.en: Thus (it will happen,) and We will marry them with houris having big dark eyes.

verses.ar: يَدۡعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They will call therein for every fruit peacefully.

verses.ar: لَا يَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا الۡمَوۡتَ اِلَّا الۡمَوۡتَةَ الۡاُوۡلٰيۚ وَوَقٰىهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: They will not taste death therein beyond the first death (they faced in the world). And He (Allah) will save them from the torment of Hell,

verses.ar: فَضۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُ
verses.en: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great achievement.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, We had made it (the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue, so that they may take lesson.

verses.ar: فَارۡتَقِبۡ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّرۡتَقِبُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Now wait. They too are waiting.
